summary: The qaṭəl-shaped Preterit Intransitive takes unmarked path NPs as well as b-, ʕal and l-goal phrases; its box name must not be taken as a prohibition on route objects. I Preterit l-agent forms at 115/102 and 115/260 also express traversal.

III usually adds a conveyed participant (person, cat, horses), with object clitics and route/goal expressions. 67/77 already illustrates III with the rider himself crossing; no new numbered sense is needed for that inherited example.

qṭʕ 1 was consulted with the permitted lookup. Its l-qamuṯo idiom already covers overtaking/cutting ahead. Do not duplicate that idiom here; the cross-entry filing inconsistency remains an editorial question.
